spec.name: limits
spec.text:
# P27: the live chassis' angular limits, one row. The bike chain is P21's (its capture/extra.toml).
[watch]
name        = "limits"
description = "the bike chassis' speed and angular limits"
every       = 1
frames      = 3

[setup]
state  = 8
warmup = 30

[[field]]
name = "rider_type"
addr = "@game_manager -> 0x34 -> 0x34 -> 0x8 -> 0x8 -> 0x0 -> 0x0"
type = "u32"

[[field]]
name = "max_speed_sq"
addr = "@game_manager -> 0x34 -> 0x34 -> 0x8 -> 0x8 -> 0x0 -> 0x7a4 -> 0x220"
type = "f32"

[[field]]
name = "max_ang_speed_sq"
addr = "@game_manager -> 0x34 -> 0x34 -> 0x8 -> 0x8 -> 0x0 -> 0x7a4 -> 0x224"
type = "f32"

[[field]]
name = "ang_vel_max"
addr = "@game_manager -> 0x34 -> 0x34 -> 0x8 -> 0x8 -> 0x0 -> 0x7a4 -> 0x230"
type = "f32x4"

[[field]]
name = "ang_vel_min"
addr = "@game_manager -> 0x34 -> 0x34 -> 0x8 -> 0x8 -> 0x0 -> 0x7a4 -> 0x240"
type = "f32x4"
